description: This file implements quantized multiplication operations for PyTorch, including functions for tensor multiplication, scalar multiplication, and integration with XNNPACK and oneDNN backends. It defines dispatchers, utility functions, and registers operators for quantized multiplication with support for ReLU fusion.

classes.description: Class for performing quantized multiplication with optional ReLU fusion.

classes.name: QMulScalarOut
classes.description: Class for scalar quantized multiplication with output tensor.

classes.name: QMulOnednn
classes.description: Class for performing quantized multiplication using oneDNN backend.
